text:
No. The Great Wall isn't visible to the naked eye from the Moon (about 384,000 km away), and the claim in the previous message is false. No human-made structure is visible from there.

The wall is long but mostly under 10 m wide and similar in color to the terrain around it. Even from low Earth orbit (~400 km) it's very hard to pick out unaided. Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei said in 2003 that he couldn't see it, and astronauts have photographed it from orbit only with zoom lenses and favorable lighting.
